title: English for International Economics and Business

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to communicate effectively in English in international business contexts.
Students will understand and be able to apply principles of international trade, including contracts, invoices, and shipping documents.
Students will be able to draft and propose international investment projects.
Students will be able to draft international business contracts.
Students will achieve a minimum IELTS score of 5.5.
Students will work effectively in teams and independently.
Students will adapt to changing international business environments.
Students will analyze and solve problems in international business scenarios.
